title: Noor and the Confession
premise: Noor Adeyemi, a concierge at the Grand Meridian Hotel, has built a quiet career on noticing what guests hide — and closing cases no one else can. When a guest vanishes and her diary turns up in Noor's lost-and-found with entries written after her disappearance, Noor realizes someone is staging the woman's life to frame a dead man. Following the diary's forged trail, she discovers the 'dead' witness is alive, hidden inside the hotel itself by a powerful family whose patriarch's confession the missing woman was carrying. To save them both, Noor must choose between exposing the family — and losing the found-family of hotel staff who owe them everything.
about_author: Emrys Ishikawa is the pen name of a former night-desk clerk who spent six years collecting the secrets of a luxury hotel lobby. They write mysteries about people who see everything and are believed by no one.

chapters.title: The Lost and Found
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Establishing her meticulous world at the Grand Meridian: she reads guests like ledgers and closes small cases for tips and gratitude. A police detective arrives asking about vanished guest Celeste Marchand, and Noor recognizes the diary in the evidence photo as one she logged weeks ago. Beat: pride curdling into unease.

chapters.title: Entries After the End
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. She retrieves the diary from storage and finds entries dated after Celeste disappeared — handwriting that mimics hers but gets details wrong only an outsider would miss. Someone is authoring Celeste. Noor breaks her own rule and takes the case off-book. Beat: obsession kindling.

chapters.title: The Family on the Twelfth Floor
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. The diary's forged entries point toward the Voss family, who quietly own half the hotel and have kept the twelfth floor closed for years. Noor befriends elderly housekeeper Marta, who remembers a witness named Ilya who 'died' a decade ago. Beat: dread beneath gilded surfaces.

chapters.title: What Marta Remembers
chapters.summary: Marta's POV flashback braided with present. Marta recalls Ilya Kessler, an accountant who saw what Edmund Voss did to his business partner — and who was declared dead after a fire. Marta has been leaving groceries at a sealed service door for years without admitting why. Beat: complicity and guilt.

chapters.title: A Case Noor Can't Close
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. The detective warns her off; then her mentor, front-office manager Salim, is suspended for 'leaks' — pressure meant to break the staff's loyalty. Noor realizes the Vosses know she's looking. First sabotage: her records vanish. Beat: fear replacing confidence.

chapters.title: The Sealed Door
chapters.summary: Noor's POV, night shift. Using her master-key knowledge, Noor reaches the sealed corridor and finds Ilya Kessler alive, aged and hiding in the old linen rooms — fed, protected, and terrified. He refuses to testify; confession or not, he believes the Vosses will kill Celeste if he speaks. Beat: the case becomes human.

chapters.title: Confession, Recorded
chapters.summary: Ilya's POV. He reveals he recorded Edmund Voss's drunken confession years ago and hid the tape inside the hotel — but the diary-forger is Edmund's son Adrian, trying to bury the past before his father dies and the estate is audited. Ilya begs Noor to find Celeste before Adrian does. Beat: love against duty — Ilya stayed hidden to protect a daughter he's never met.

chapters.title: The Forger's Hand
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Decoding the diary's errors as deliberate clues, Noor traces Adrian's movements through hotel logs and realizes Celeste is being held in the Voss penthouse, 'recovering' from a fictional breakdown. Salim returns, offering to help — revealing he's been reporting to the Vosses to protect the staff. Betrayal and forgiveness collide. Beat: trust shattered and rebuilt.

chapters.title: Twelfth Floor, Last Night
chapters.summary: Noor's POV, climax. During a blackout gala, Noor, Marta, Salim, and Ilya move together: Ilya surrenders his hiding place to play the confession over the hotel PA while Noor reaches Celeste. Adrian corners Noor; Salim takes the blow meant for her. Police arrive to the sound of Edmund's own voice. Beat: sacrifice, courage, the found family holding.

chapters.title: Checkout
chapters.summary: Noor's POV, resolution. Adrian is arrested; Edmund dies before trial, his confession public anyway. Celeste recovers and takes a long-stay suite; Ilya meets his daughter in the lobby where it all began. Noor declines the detective's job offer — the hotel is her family, its secrets now hers to keep kindly. Final beat: she logs a new diary in lost-and-found, and lets it stay lost.
